entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add Import isn't offered for an extension method when .NET 10's AsyncEnumerable method of the same name gives CS0411 (EF Core's FirstOrDefaultAsync) #86623
  • `summary` annotation are not inserted automatically if the union is declared using the keyword `union`. #86622
  • Union creation expression requires a `CollectionBuilderAttribute` on it, but only if the collection value is specified inline and without the `new` keyword. #86621

Closed

  • Spurious CS8655 when an awaited union switch is deconstructed #86608
    18.15

PullRequests

Created

  • Replace path-separator checks in PlatformInformation with RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform #86628
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add src/ProjectData to CODEOWNERS #86626
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Extract component imports #86618
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Revert "Removing legacy DTL DartLab templates" #86627
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Put type parameter inference from constraints behind a feature flag. #86624
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Type Inference from Constraints, Next
  • Add a regression test for #86608 #86625
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Document inference dependency breaking change #86617
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Cache/reuse formal collection element type inferred during type argument inference #86619
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3146241 #86598
    Area-Razor
  • Avoid reusing interpolated string tokens after incremental edits #86578
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Align signature checks performed for `SynthesizedUnionCtor` with those performed for methods declared explicitly in source. #86616
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Avoid reusing constructors at Script root during incremental parsing #86576
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Inline arrays: disallow capture with address-of #86325
    Area-Compilers
  • Unsafe evolution: fix unsafe expression diagnostics #86292
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Support multithreaded ProjectData slice writes #86433
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Stop scanning preceding siblings in SyntaxNavigator.GetNextToken/GetPreviousToken #86352
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix behavior of ShebangDirectiveTriviaSyntax.Content #86607
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Run File
